title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛市曼杜里奥市镇圣拉斐尔描笼涯的圣拉斐尔-博利劳小学更名为Donato Pison纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the San Rafael-Bolilao Elementary School Situated in Barangay San Rafael, Municipality of Mandurriao, City of Iloilo, to Donato Pison Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Renaming the San Rafael-Bolilao Elementary School Situated in Barangay San Rafael, Municipality of Mandurriao, City of Iloilo, to Donato Pison Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học San Rafael-Bolilao tại Barangay San Rafael, Đô thị Mandurriao, Thành phố Iloilo thành Trường Tưởng niệm Donato Pison
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา San Rafael-Bolilao ในบารังไกย์ San Rafael เทศบาล Mandurriao เมือง Iloilo เป็นโรงเรียนอนุสรณ์ Donato Pison
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar San Rafael-Bolilao di Barangay San Rafael, Kotamadya Mandurriao, Kota Iloilo menjadi Sekolah Memorial Donato Pison
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah San Rafael-Bolilao di Barangay San Rafael, Perbandaran Mandurriao, Bandar Iloilo kepada Sekolah Memorial Donato Pison

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6703_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The San Rafael-Bolilao Elementary School in Barangay san Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, shall hereafter be known as the Donato Pison Memorial School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
